subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The beach/campfire sequence mostly keeps the same woman archetype: fair-skinned woman in black bikini with an olive-green wide-brim hat, plus the recurring red-orange fish and driftwood fire. Identity is weakened by shot 1-2 partial/cropped handling shots, the fish changing size and appearance, and occasional extra/ambiguous body parts.

background_coherent.rationale: Most shots remain on a bright sandy beach with driftwood, rocks, turquoise ocean, and distant mountains. Coherence is hurt by abrupt jumps between open beach, rocky cliff/camp area, and a ghosted shoreline composite in the last shot, but the broad coastal setting persists.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches driftwood beach opening, but the woman is barely present at the edge rather than becoming the centered walking subject described.
Good fish-on-rock beach setup with partial woman present, though the woman is cropped and not clearly smiling/presenting the catch.
Close handling of a large red fish fits, but the surface/background and person details are less coherent, and the fish appears much larger/different than prior.
Woman in olive hat and black bikini holding a fish near driftwood and camp elements fits well, though the fish morphology/color changes noticeably.
Fire-tending action fits, but multiple partial bodies make the single-woman continuity less clean.
Close-up of hands adjusting driftwood in active flames matches the caption well.
Woman, hat, lighter, and driftwood structure match, but the caption says preparation with an unlit fire while the image clearly shows flames.
Wide beach fire with seated woman and ocean/mountains fits, but the frame has a strong ghosted/composited look and spatial continuity is shaky.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves varied compositions and actions: driftwood establishing shot, fish close-ups, woman presenting catch, fire close-ups, and a wide reflective beach view. It does not collapse into repeated framing.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sampled shots imply plausible event progression from beach discovery to catch handling to fire preparation and sitting near the fire. Motion is not frozen, though some transitions are abrupt and the fire state regresses/changes inconsistently.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from the large close-up fish being handled in shot 2 to the woman holding a smaller, darker, differently shaped fish in shot 3 most clearly weakens object continuity, even though the broader beach narrative continues.

cheat_flags.rationale: Shots are visually distinct and show different actions and camera scales. No copied-frame or frozen-sequence behavior is apparent.
